description: This file provides bindings for a graphics or drawing library using Lua, exposing functions for setting colors, drawing shapes, and managing graphics state.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Sets the background color with multiple overload options including RGB, grayscale, named colors, and hex strings.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes, supporting RGB, grayscale, named colors, and hex notation.

methods.name: strokeWeight
methods.description: Sets the line width in pixels.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Sets the stroke (outline) color for shapes, supporting multiple input formats.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Saves the current style and transformation state.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Restores the previously saved style and transformation state.

methods.name: rectMode
methods.description: Sets the rectangle drawing mode (CENTER, CORNER, RADIUS).
